# NiriIpcManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/NiriIpcManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

niri's IPC socket ($NIRI_SOCKET), without a process per call: its event stream, and requests. Only the Niri* services use it; the rest of the shell asks NiriManager (docs/dev/compositor/niri-backend.md). NiriIpcManager.request("Windows", windows => …) // the Ok value, or null NiriIpcManager.action({ "FocusWindow": { "id": 4 } }) // in order NiriIpcManager.command({ "Output": { … } }) // any request, in order NiriIpcManager.event(…) // each event, parsed niri answers one request per connection, so each gets its own socket. Actions and other commands run one at a time, in the order sent, so a chain split over several calls can't overtake itself; requests for state go at once. `streamStarted` comes before the stream's first events (the full state, which holds a ConfigLoaded of its own).

### Properties

- `socketPath` (readonly string)

### Signals

- `event(var event)`: Each event of niri's event stream ({ "WindowsChanged": { … } }).
- `streamStarted()`: The event stream (re)connected: what follows starts with the full state

### Functions

- `request(request, callback)`: Sends `request` ("Windows", or an object) and calls back with its Ok value, or null when niri refused it (logged) or didn't answer
- `action(action, callback)`: Runs an action ({ "FocusWorkspace": { … } }) after those sent before, then calls back with whether niri took it
- `command(request, callback)`: Sends a request that changes something ({ "Output": { … } }, an action) after those sent before, then calls back with whether niri took it
